clausefoot.conditions: No validated per-team coverage, durable article archive or full-text training grant. Check publisher conditions and attribute.

gdelt.conditions: Discovery only. Recheck the article publisher before any automated article reuse.

interno.rights: CC BY 4.0 for own content, subject to exceptions
interno.conditions: Verify the dated notice's rights, fixture, geographic scope and exceptions. Exclude third-party material. The default is a candidate source, not a per-club article grant.

openfootball.conditions: Check ordered teams, stage, status and date. Mirrors and upstream TXT have shared lineage.

openligadb-bl1.rights: ODbL 1.0 data and separate API use terms
openligadb-bl1.conditions: Respect API policy and ODbL attribution/share-alike terms on derivative databases. Match ID, field and original source lineage require verification.

touchline.rights: Free for personal, hobbyist, academic and open-source projects under the provider's conditions
touchline.conditions: Credit and link Tactical Data by Touchline Wire. Confirm use scope and endpoint membership. Scope alone cannot attest any club's latest report, absence, or a confirmed starting XI.

wikidata.conditions: Inspect competition, qualifiers, dates, subject identity and origin per statement.

wikipedia.rights: Normally CC BY-SA 4.0 for eligible page text
wikipedia.conditions: Record every particular page/revision, authors, licence, edits and template dependencies. Linked articles, images and third-party quotations require their own grant. An encyclopedia roster cannot establish a matchday XI.
